source: Median of 3 fresh-process runs of scripts/profile-scheduled-calculation.ts on artifact c904767465cb… (feed 20260803, 9,313 station areas, 2,075,789 connections). Mirrors the 'Current baseline' table in calculation-baseline.md. Committed so hotspot shares are auditable without the gitignored CPU profile.

hotspot2MunichBoundary.definition: Wall-clock time spent in isWithinOfficialMunichBoundary across buildScheduledStationAreaCatalog (all 9,313 station areas) and response validation (1,115 result areas).
hotspot2MunichBoundary.basis: The boundary check is a subset of the catalog-build and validation stages. Their measured wall-clock time (1,584 ms + 2,069 ms = 3,653 ms) is 11.1% of the 32,857 ms total, so the boundary-specific portion cannot exceed that. The earlier ~29% CPU-profile frame attribution overstated wall-clock because those frames are sampled inside stages whose total time is only 11.1% of the run. A conservative ~5% (~1.7 s) reflects the boundary-specific portion; expected optimization gain is therefore scaled to ~1-2 s (not 8-10 s).
